content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, thank you for sending over the contract. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a minor adjustment to the agreement before I sign. Specifically, in the relevant clause regarding payment terms, payment is currently set at ninety days from the effective date. - Regarding the clause stating '$ 115,250.00      Net ninety (90) days from the Effective Date                                     of this Agreement.', waiting ninety days creates cash flow delays, so I propose updating this to state that the second installment of $115,250.00 shall be due and payable Net thirty (30) days from invoice date. Please let me know if this works for you so we can move forward. Best regards,
